observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D7500' visible on the top right. The lens mount is covered by a cap with 'Nikon' and 'D7500' engraved. The camera has a textured grip, a mode dial, and a red accent on the grip.
Photo 1: Rear view showing the LCD screen, control buttons (MENU, WB, QUAL, etc.), and the top of the camera. The screen is off and reflects light. A strap is attached to the camera.
Photo 2: Side view showing the top LCD screen, mode dial, and the left side of the camera. The camera appears to be in a used condition with some dust and minor wear. The strap is still attached.
All photos show the camera body only, no lens, no battery, no charger, no screen or sensor visible. The background is a store shelf with other cameras, suggesting a retail or second-hand environment.

claims.claim: Clean UK Used Nikon D7500 DSLR Professional Camera Body Only
claims.evidence: The camera appears clean in photos, but 'UK Used' and 'Professional Camera Body Only' cannot be verified remotely. No proof of origin or completeness (e.g., no battery, charger, or lens).
No video or photo of the camera powering on, taking a photo, or operating. The screen is off in photo 1, and no internal components are visible.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: Video or photo of the camera turning on, showing the LCD screen and menu navigation.

risks.risk: Sensor may be damaged or dirty
risks.proof: Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed, showing the surface.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor may be damaged

risks.risk: Battery, charger, or other accessories may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery, charger, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no accessories

risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count display in the camera menu or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter count, which reduces value

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powering on and operating.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo showing the battery, charger, and any included accessories.
Photo of the shutter count display in the camera menu.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
